scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev -w src/backend" "npm run dev -w src/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w src/frontend && npm run build -w src/backend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run start -w src/backend" "npm run start -w src/frontend"
scripts.docker:dev:watch: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml watch
